notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We heard your feedback, that some people had issues with figuring out how the menu's work. So we created a patch with improves some key issues that people experienced. 


 Made the enter key work as a confirmation in the menu's.
 When using keyboard, you don't need to hold the back button anymore in the menu's to go back.
 Added the instruction to use WASD keys to select a language in the initial language menu.
